v0.2.0 多格式通用化：JSONL/JSON/SQLite/Markdown/Binary 五大格式族 + discover 全源登记 + --source/--kind/--format 过滤 + 配置兜底；默认检索范围=会话+结构化记忆开、自由笔记/二进制日志关。139/139 测试全绿。

Initial release of yotta-logs.

- Provides zero-dependency retrieval and analysis of session JSONL logs for conversation history tracking.
- Supports keyword and regex search, filtering by date/session/role, statistics, and tool usage ranking—all through simple CLI commands.
- Automatically redacts sensitive information by default, ensuring local privacy and safety.
- Ensures strict read-only access: no log modification/deletion, no network upload, local logs only.
- Designed as a raw log retrieval tool complementary to semantic memory solutions, focusing on original conversation traceability.
